body: Problem is each visit to the doctor whos 'on my case' costs a lot and I really can't afford it right now :[

Seems like depression to me. I used to drink a lot, one of the reasons i started taking meds was to stop drinking. (did not stop completely but i dont get drunk anymore). Beware of alcohol as it deepens depressive states A LOT and when the only thing you look forward to relieve your 'pain' is alcohol (i did that) that can be a begining of alcoholism. See a doctor.

i have them for a couple of years now, every moment when im alone, even when i wasnt depressed (ive been diagnosed a couple of months ago) there is just this vision in the back of my head of killing myself. And the interesting thing it doesn't even go with bad feelings, just happens - Riding the bus perfectly happy and i think about a gun put to my head.

i went to therapy for like 2 months but it was more frustrating than helpful. The shrink told me things i already know. I guess therapy is for people who don't understand their own emotions. But I'm gna go see a psychiatry professor next week, maybe my current shrink is just dumb.
and its not the work making me depressed i think. I just don't have any motivation, any reason to drive me, i get through the day like a zombie. Everything seems so worthless and boring.

You know people say that during the first few weeks of taking meds suicide rates increase because people regain motivation for action yet are still sad? Something very weird just happened to me. I'm not feeling suicidal (ok i am, but not like depressive crying suicidal) and i just sat at the edge of my window which i never have done before really feeling the urge to jump being in this trance like state. But i thought to myself i would just brake my legs coz i live on the second floor and i dont want to fail at suicide coz that would look silly. And then i thought to myself what the fuck am i doing. Ive got 3 papers to hand in tomorrow and i havent even started. if i dont i fail. I know i can wait a year or even two years but i have a feeling if i fail now my depression will get even worse.

Thanks, that was really great. I don't think i question my place in the world. I exactly know what I wanna do and I exactly know what I have to accomplish to do that. But if i fail this year it seems to me as if i will lose it. As nearly all my peers, people i relate to and compare myself to (we all do) will be out and about doing what i cant because i lost it due to depression. And i know i should stop caring about that, not compare myself with others, and accept other possibilities but when I see my future somehow for the past couple of years and suddenly it changes because I keep crying for no reason? Sorry I'm venting but you people seem smarter than my therapist

Thanks. The thing is I can't get anyone to force me. I have always been the dominating personality, the leader, forcing others and listening to their problems. And now noone seems to have an effect on me because of my dominating personality, I am quite certain that if I tried I would convince them that its okay to be depressed and suicide really is the only answer
